 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__**Shifting cultivation:**__

__
 
• It is a form of agricultural practice in which farmers clear an area of land by slashing vegetation and burning forests for agricultural practices.
 
• This practice is also known as** slash-and-burn** agriculture.
 
• **Shifting cultivation **is called by different names in different parts of India.
 
• In **Jharkhand**, the slash-and-burn agriculture is known as **Kuruwa**, in **Andhra Pradesh** it is called **Podu**, and in **Odisha,** it is known as **Koman**.
 
• It is the primitive subsistence agriculture that is practiced on small patches of land.
 
• **Jhumming is the local name for shifting cultivation in Jharkhand.**
